text: {"name":"ke_env_copy_fields","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Reads the KE environment record from MEMD, copies mask-selected payload blocks into the output buffer, and returns status codes for bad magic, no matching flags, or a declared output size smaller than the copied data.","subsystem":"ke","var_renames":{"a1":"request_mask","a2":"out_buf","a3":"out_capacity","v6":"bytes_copied","v8":"record_magic","v9":"record_flags"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Record magic checked against the expected KE environment magic."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Record flags tested against the request mask."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"6-byte payload selected by mask bit 0x2."},{"offset":292,"meaning":"2-byte payload selected by mask bit 0x100000."},{"offset":296,"meaning":"8-byte payload selected by mask bit 0x200000."},{"offset":304,"meaning":"4-byte payload selected by mask bit 0x400000."},{"offset":308,"meaning":"2-byte payload selected by mask bit 0x800000."},{"offset":310,"meaning":"10-byte payload selected by mask bit 0x1000000."}]}
